facts: 9 springs (0-140 m altitude); 30+ stone tanks: ~10 troughs (γούρνες, ~3 m3) and 21 open-air cisterns (χαβούζες, 15-20 m3), 5 of them communal; furrows (κουτέντο); ~15.5 ha irrigated; ~21,000 m3 of hand-built stone; water shared in 12-hour spans called 'waters', by weekday; rights inhere in the land; overflows (στραγγίδια) shared by trust
status: declining: 6 farmers in 2022 (4 over 75), >25 in the 1980s

facts: Unwritten until early 20th c.; then in sale contracts and inheritance deeds; informal monitor (an elder); disputes settled by oral agreement and the evidence of stone furrows; the 2015 cadastre split a communal cistern from its spring

place: Tris Piges, Tosso Nero, Abourdektis and others
system: Public springs and a small pond
